hints.title: Distinct Subjects Counting
hints.text: Each teacher can teach the same subject across multiple departments.

hints.title: Group by Teacher Identifier
hints.text: Group records by teacher id to partition classes by instructor.

hints.title: Distinct Aggregation
hints.text: Apply count distinct on subject id to count unique subjects per teacher.

hints.title: Group Count Query Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
select
    teacher_id,
    count(distinct subject_id) as cnt
from Teacher
group by teacher_id;
```

variables: n: number of rows in Teacher table
complexity.notes: Hash group by with distinct subject set evaluation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning table repeatedly per teacher causes inefficient table sweeps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Aggregate hash map tracks distinct subject sets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies group by and count distinct idiomatically.

solutions.code:
select
    teacher_id,
    count(distinct subject_id) as cnt
from Teacher
group by teacher_id;
